1.title: Stop Renting Your AI's Memory — Dylan Couzon, Qdrant
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Live demo of embedded vector memory (Qdrant Edge) running fully offline on a drone with sub-millisecond retrieval in a 15 MB footprint, plus the architecture pattern (model = CPU, context = RAM, memory = disk).

1.title: MCP Doesn't Suck. Your Agent Does. — Jan Čurn, Apify
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Three concrete fixes to MCP implementation (sub-agents, progressive tool discovery, Code Mode) with live demos and comparative evals (raw MCP vs CLI vs mcpc) showing which approach wins where.

2.title: Your Coding Agent Is 6 Months Out of Date — Jakub Hojsan, Exa
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Knowledge-cutoff gap breaks code-review agents; Exa shows how to give agents explicit rules for when to search, and token-efficient highlights that compress 100k characters to 500 with no latency.
